objective: Frozen two-index Brooks-inspired context interpretation, underlying trade plans and paper trade lifecycle evaluation

add_policy.common_stop_policy: Never widen the original structural stop; reserve total episode risk before initial entry

evaluation.uncertainty_method: Predeclare session/block-based estimates preserving paired-index dependence
evaluation.ambiguous_bar_policy: Flag and report pessimistic/optimistic bounds, never favorable path assumption
evaluation.forward_changes_policy: No silent changes; new versions retain failures and require new attribution/evidence
evaluation.insufficient_evidence_policy: Remain paper/observe; no forced trade count or success claim
evaluation.qualitative_examples_policy: Research-only classification labels; never submittable production CANDIDATE without numeric fields, policy and identity
evaluation.probability_calibration_policy: No numerical probability until calibrated out of sample for the same context, objective, stop and management policy
evaluation.paper_outcome_units: Underlying points and defined paper R; actual instrument monetary PnL deferred
evaluation.opportunity_labeling_policy: Cutoff-only eligible windows labelled before outcomes; sampled hindsight swings are development examples, not denominator evidence
evaluation.identification_endpoint: Context/sequence agreement, causal eligible routes captured/rejected/missed; no required trade quota
evaluation.target_endpoint: Compare first-opposition and measured-swing policies on identical frozen entries/stops, accounting for observation censoring/ambiguity
evaluation.execution_endpoint: Actual close-to-decision/acceptance/trigger latency and expiry losses; simulated latency remains separately labelled
evaluation.trial_preservation: Frozen earlier replay policies/results remain unchanged. v0.6 is a new development revision; inspected dates cannot validate improvement.
